decisions.statement: Which keys a page has a phone number under is read from the page types declaring the keys.
The page types that can carry a phone number are read from `phone-number-property` down.
A page type the change itself puts under `phone-number-property` counts.
A page's type is read from its file name rather than from its body.
A page whose type carries no phone number is never opened.
An audit collects the pages of those types rather than every file in the tree.
A page's value is read through the shadow of the change being judged.
A value stated as a list has each entry in the list judged.
A value that is not text is refused rather than passed over.
A page whose body will not load is passed over.
`page-matches-its-type` refuses a body that will not load.

definition: the check refusing a phone number that is not written in E.164
